visualCharacteristics.notes: First item is a tall featured card with date, NEWS RELEASE label, title and LEARN MORE in white over a darkened image; the remaining items form a stacked list beside it on desktop (thumbnail left, date/title/LEARN MORE right). Everything stacks on mobile.

contentPattern.structure: one row per news item: image | date paragraph + optional label paragraph (e.g. NEWS RELEASE) + title heading (e.g. h3) + LEARN MORE link; the first row is the featured card

suitableFor: news / press release teasers with one featured item
notSuitableFor: image-top promo cards with body copy (use cards-promo)
